claims.text: SITC provided written notice to the NYSE on October 15, 2026, of its intention to voluntarily delist its common shares after the sale of its Dividend Trust Portfolio joint-venture interests.

citation.quote: On October 15, 2026, the Company, in accordance with authority granted by the Company’s Board of Directors that became effective upon the sale of the Company’s interests in the Dividend Trust Portfolio joint venture, provided written notice to the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) of its intention to voluntarily de-list its common shares

claims.text: SITC intends to file Form 25 on November 23, 2026, and expects the delisting to take effect before trading begins on December 4, 2026.

citation.quote: The Company intends to file a Form 25 with the Securities and Exchange Commission relating to the de-listing of the Common Shares on November 23, 2026. The Company expects that the de-listing of the Common Shares will be effective prior to the commencement of trading on December 4, 2026.

claims.text: The affected securities are SITC common shares with a $0.10 par value listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

citation.quote: Common Shares, Par Value $0.10 Per Share | SITC | New York Stock Exchange

claims.text: SITC operates as a REIT owning, leasing, redeveloping, and managing shopping centers; as of June 30, 2026, its portfolio had 14 shopping centers, including 10 held through the Dividend Trust Portfolio joint venture.

citation.quote: The Company is a self-administered and self-managed Real Estate Investment Trust (“REIT”) in the business of owning, leasing, redeveloping, and managing shopping centers. As of June 30, 2026, the Company’s portfolio consisted of 14 shopping centers (including 10 shopping centers owned through the Dividend Trust Portfolio (“DTP”), an unconsolidated joint venture).
